sourceLineBasis: Native source anchors describe the reviewed b48683b base, before the separately authorized usage/compression implementation. Subsequent changes must be recorded in postReviewChanges with their own current source hashes/lines.

postReviewChanges.change: Bounded provider usage +automatic compression now implemented after the reviewed base; base capability statuses/line anchors remain historical.
postReviewChanges.evidence: 31 new usage +4 settings;247 prior regression cases, all pass in private focused run.
remaining: No full Stagewise parity claim. Full Node Buffer/builtins/importModule, archival memory/plans, LSP/research/cloud-provider gaps remain in parity-review-core.json.

Usage records represent the latest provider request, not lifetime token/cost accounting. No currency pricing, billing reconciliation, account/subscription warning calculation or tokenizer implementation.

Missing/malformed counters remain unknown; no guessed model context size. Counters on failed requests without retained assistant payload are not a durable billing ledger. Unknown compatible-provider usage schemas are not normalized.

Automatic compression waits at a complete tool-batch boundary (or final turn) rather than racing the next generation in the background. A utility failure keeps full history and resumes the suspended action; cancellation stops it.

Retained history uses the existing approximate JSON-byte token estimate,12 preferred canonical rows and user-turn alignment. Canonical native tool results are separate rows, so this is not exact source UI-message counting/tokenization.

Unknown contextWindowTokens disables automatic compression; manual /compact remains available. Explicit model limit and valid discovered inputTokenLimit are supported; no broad per-vendor catalog inference.

Automatic briefing writes preserve original rows and existing attachment/native metadata. History is persisted through existing host save/queue callbacks; no new transactional crash journal is claimed.

Chat Completions requests now ask stream_options.include_usage=true. Local fixtures cover all four protocols, not every real OpenAI-compatible endpoint accepting that option; no live services or real credentials used.
ProviderDialog is tested through actual widgets offscreen. This does not establish full visual parity or application deployment validation.

scope: Source-level core/agent/provider/streaming/context/sandbox/tool API comparison. Native C++ is assessed for behavior, not literal TypeScript line translation. UI/platform/integrations have separate peer reports.
conclusion: Full Stagewise parity is NOT established and is contradicted by explicit unsupported native paths and absent subsystems. Preserved upstream source is not a native implementation.
reviewMethod: Read pinned upstream contracts and corresponding native implementations. Every capability below has verified file/line anchors and canonical source hashes.
Mapped every agent_command/provider/tool row and selected core-owned agents/workspace/procedure rows from the 701-row inventory to a capability or explicit shared-review boundary.
This is a semantic capability audit, not proof that every upstream function/body line was ported. Root owns the global function/source inventory.
No production edits, tests, private credentials/history, UI automation or remote calls during this review.

statusSemantics.implemented_with_limits: Native implementation plus named exercised fixtures; explicit constraints remain. Not complete parity.
statusSemantics.partial: Material native subset exists but specified upstream behavior is missing or different.
statusSemantics.missing: Concrete absent/unsupported native capability; counterpart entry points and upstream implementation identified.
statusSemantics.shared_review: Implemented native plumbing exists, but detailed behavior belongs another domain review and is not certified here.

capabilities.title: Four model wire protocols
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Native Qt networking serializes Chat Completions, Responses, Anthropic Messages and Google GenerateContent and parses streamed tool/text output.
remaining: Four protocol implementations do not equal all 26 upstream provider adapters; vendor authentication/options and SDK behavior are separately assessed.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Streaming order, interruption and cancellation
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Incremental SSE/text/tool fragments, provisional-to-retained display identities, partial canceled history and generation/lifetime guards are implemented.
remaining: Native step/output/deadline caps differ from the SDK/runtime; recorded fixture scope is not every malformed provider event.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Reasoning presentation and signed replay
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Reasoning text/duration and provider/model-bound signed native blocks are preserved, with UI-only metadata excluded from provider messages.
remaining: Full upstream reasoning-source identity includes routed vendor/provider-mode/apiSpec distinctions not present in the smaller ProviderConfig.
Thinking-selection defaults, model capability validation and provider-option merge rules are not fully ported.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Ordered preset fallback and retries
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Ordered configured models, five-minute fallback persistence, preset/signature invalidation, cancellation reset and bounded transient retries are present.
remaining: Transport retries are native policy, not a proof of identical AI SDK retry classification/backoff.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Durable queued messages
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Enqueue/edit/remove/move/send-now/resume, success drain, atomic host queue/history commit and paused stop/failure/restart behavior are implemented.
remaining: Background watcher retry is process-local; see integration audit. Queue persistence depends on host QueueCommitter, not standalone Engine alone.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Structured user questions
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Opt-in typed multistep forms, backtracking, draft answers, opaque phase tokens, interrupt/cancel results and four-protocol associations exist.
remaining: Pending question UI is not restored as an active form after process restart; inherited pending tool history is settled before another send. Headless hosts intentionally do not advertise questions.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Tool approval and explicit denial
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Per-call approval/denial, read-only exceptions and per-chat always-allow setting are available; stale external requests are correlated.
remaining: Upstream smart shell approval classifier and all approval-policy semantics are not implemented; native has a simpler explicit policy.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Interrupted inherited tool-call recovery
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Unresolved inherited calls receive exactly one error result before new input; original source history and native blocks remain unchanged; malformed associations reject atomically.
remaining: Known native call IDs/names/order are validated; this is not a complete semantic comparison of arbitrary signed provider payloads.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Retry, replace and revert conversation turns
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Native file-mutation undo is implemented separately; it is not conversation retry/edit/revert.
remaining: No native equivalents of retryLastUserMessage, replaceUserMessage or revertToUserMessage with their history/tool undo semantics were found in Engine or current conversation controls.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Tool schema validation and repair diagnostics
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Malformed JSON objects and individual native tool argument checks return errors to the model.
remaining: No complete shared JSON-schema validator or upstream repairToolCall diagnostic classification; some native tools use toString/toBool defaults rather than the source schema semantics.

native.anchor: Tool arguments are not a JSON object.

capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Title generation and utility fallback
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Configured title/compression model chains fall back to the main chain; bounded utility calls, title sanitization and guarded native title application exist.
remaining: No identical upstream hardcoded utility-default model registry or every provider-option policy; UI ownership/rename semantics are reviewed separately.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Manual history compression
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Main-chat /compact uses UtilityService, stores a briefing at a user-turn boundary and retains original saved messages/tool pairs.
remaining: Boundary estimate uses serialized bytes/4 rather than the complete source token accounting. MainWindow passes the default boundary context limit; model-aware automatic triggering is absent. Side-chat /compact is still ordinary text.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Automatic context compression
capabilities.nativeBehavior: No automatic trigger is connected to provider-step usage in the current native engine.
remaining: Upstream triggers after a completed step at min(configured context fraction,100000 tokens), retains at most min(20% context,40000 tokens), and guards concurrent/stale compression. Native only exposes manual compression.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Provider token and cache accounting
capabilities.nativeBehavior: maxOutputTokens limits exist, but Engine does not retain or aggregate input/output/cache/reasoning token usage.
remaining: OpenAI usage-only SSE, Anthropic split usage, Google usageMetadata and Responses usage are not consumed into state. No usedTokens/context warning/cost/billing equivalence.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: System prompt and environment-domain conversion
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Native assistant instructions, read-only context roster, tool capabilities and a dynamic shell manifest are injected into requests.
remaining: Not a port of the full source prompt builder, soul/output protocols/authority fragments or ordered domain registry.
No source-equivalent per-message environment keyframes/deltas for workspace,fileDiffs,agentsMd,skills,memory,plans,logs,browser,shells,sandbox,activeApp,logIngest.

native.anchor: You are ADE, a native agentic IDE

capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Archival memory mount and global index
capabilities.nativeBehavior: The native compression briefing uses a memory XML tag; this is not the source archival memory service.
remaining: No per-agent history.md/history.jsonl/metadata.json archive writer, shared memory/index registry, lifecycle snapshot updates or readonly memory/ mount.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Owned plan files and active-plan environment
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Ordinary workspace text files can be edited, but no native plan subsystem is implemented.
remaining: No plans/ ownership tracking, Markdown task parsing, active-plan manifest or progress/delta injection.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: AGENTS.md and enabled skill context
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Workspace-root AGENTS, optional scoped ancestors, workspace/global/custom/plugin skills, invocation metadata and bounded readContext are implemented.
remaining: Loader uses explicit bounds and read-only UTF-8 references; it is not every upstream context-file/media feature. Nested AGENTS discovery is an optional native relevantPaths extension, not automatic whole-tree scanning. Plugin discovery/enable semantics are also reviewed by integrations.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Workspace and virtual mount model
capabilities.nativeBehavior: One current workspace with ws1/w1 aliases plus separate per-chat apps/, readonly att/ and shells/ sources is available.
remaining: Not the source multi-workspace mount manager with multiple IDs/permissions; memory/, plans/, logs/, skill/plugin mounts are not generally exposed through native fs. Source tree/file-watcher behavior is a separate UI/integration review.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Formatted read/ls snapshots and reinjection
capabilities.nativeBehavior: A formatted read captures bytes/typed directory manifest once, stores per-call immutable snapshot/ranges, persists references and reinjects media with protocol tool associations; restart/fork/delete are lease-bound.
remaining: Native limits and storage design differ; non-Windows pinning is weaker. Concurrent in-place writes are bounded captures, not an atomic file-content snapshot.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Attachment and file transformations
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Native text/Markdown/SVG/binary metadata/directory/image handling and bounded ZIP/JAR/WAR/TAR/TGZ listings exist; original references/snapshots persist.
remaining: PDF/Office/raw-camera/disk-image/source-code AST outline and broad audio/video transformations are not fully native; unsupported types return explicit placeholders. Archive extraction/execution is not performed.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Write/edit/mkdir/copy/move/delete and undo
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Native journaled file/directory mutation callbacks, before/after byte snapshots and guarded undo/recovery are integrated with tools and raw sandbox writes.
remaining: Filesystem ACL/metadata semantics, unlimited transaction sizes, source model _diff summaries and conversation revert are not identical. Detailed journal/Git review belongs integrations.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Glob and regular-expression content search
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Workspace-scoped native glob and grepSearch support bounded recursive search without following child junctions.
remaining: Native patterns, exclusions, traversal/file/output budgets and ordering are not a complete ripgrep/glob-option port.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Library documentation search tools
capabilities.nativeBehavior: listLibraryDocs and searchInLibraryDocs are not in the native tool registry.
remaining: No native library-doc listing/search service or compatible runtime tool implementations.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Language-server lint diagnostics tool
capabilities.nativeBehavior: The native editor exists but getLintingDiagnostics is not a native model tool.
remaining: Source LSP client and TypeScript/ESLint/Biome/clangd/rust-analyzer server integrations are not ported.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Persistent JavaScript and bounded worker execution
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Separate native QuickJS process, persistent per-agent globals, async IIFEs, timers, host RPC correlation and cancellation/memory/output limits exist.
remaining: QuickJS is not Node VM; compatibility globals/modules and numeric/resource limits must be assessed independently. Context resets on fatal limits/cancel intentionally discard that realm.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Buffer compatibility
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Buffer.from/isBuffer/alloc/concat/toString/toJSON support basic UTF-8/base64/Latin1 binary attachment and file workflows.
remaining: Not the Node Buffer API: hex/UTF-16 and other encodings, byteLength/compare, numeric read/write helpers, offset/length overloads and Node shared-slice semantics are not implemented/verified. Tests named BasicBuffer do not establish full compatibility.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Allowed computational Node modules
capabilities.nativeBehavior: require supports only fs, fs/promises and the small buffer shim.
remaining: Source allows crypto,events,path,querystring,stream,string_decoder,url,util,zlib,assert. Native require throws for them; unchanged scripts using those modules fail.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: HTTPS ESM imports and session cache
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Native importModule unconditionally throws unsupported.
remaining: Source HTTPS loader, esm.sh bundle-wrapper resolution and per-session ESM cache are absent; this blocks dependent npm/Remotion recipes. No remote-module validation was run in this audit.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Sandbox filesystem API compatibility
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Async/promise and callback readFile/writeFile/mkdir/readdir with exact UTF-8/binary data route through scoped native brokers; sync APIs explicitly throw.
remaining: stat/lstat/rm/unlink/rename/copyFile/appendFile/access, sync APIs, streams, file handles and broad options remain unsupported despite upstream standard fs exposure.
Raw reads/writes use explicit 4 MiB bounds; formatted logs have a distinct bounded path.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Fetch and Web API subset
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Buffered Headers/Request/Response, AbortController/AbortSignal, UTF-8 TextEncoder/Decoder and global fetch are implemented through the native broker.
remaining: No streaming response bodies, Blob/FormData, URL/URLSearchParams, structuredClone or crypto.randomUUID globals. TextEncoder.encodeInto and full TextDecoder encoding/stream options are not implemented.
Request options/credentials modes and body sizes are deliberately restricted.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Output, attachments, CDP and persistent app events
capabilities.nativeBehavior: API.output/createAttachment/sendCDP/onCDPEvent/openApp/closeApp/sendMessage/onMessage/getCredential are host-brokered and agent-correlated.
remaining: Browser/app lifecycle, credential origin rules and bundled-plugin end-to-end scope are separately reviewed; not every CDP method or real third-party account interaction is verified.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Provider storage, discovery and validation
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Windows DPAPI records, bounded model catalog discovery/pagination and small validation requests exist; arbitrary registered protocol endpoints can be configured manually.
remaining: No source-equivalent provider instance registry, all account auth methods or every provider model-catalog schema. Key import endpoint presets are a subset, not account availability proof.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Provider routing, thinking and cache options
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Native protocol adapters expose reasoning effort/thinking mode/budget and selected output-token fields.
remaining: Source model aliases, per-vendor thinking presets/capabilities, apiSpec-aware options, request headers, provider-option deep merge, prompt cache breakpoints and routed reasoning-source semantics are not fully replicated.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Cloud, hosted and external agent adapters
capabilities.nativeBehavior: The four generic native wire protocols are not implementations of cloud signing or external agent harnesses.
remaining: Missing Stagewise hosted provider/subscription flow, Azure deployment/api-version auth, Bedrock AWS signing/profile/default chain, Vertex service-account/ADC, Codex/ChatGPT OAuth/app-server, Claude Code/OpenCode ACP and coding-plan account adapters. Generic compatible endpoints are only a manually configured subset.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Conversation lifecycle and persisted chat controls
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Native MainWindow/SessionStore lifecycle exists; this core review checks inherited history preservation rather than certifying every UI command.
remaining: Create/fork/side-chat/promote/archive/delete/read-state/history APIs require the dedicated UI parity report; direct Qt calls are not the source Karton command protocol.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

capabilities.title: Shell and browser runtime tools
capabilities.nativeBehavior: Native persistent shell service and browser bridge are wired through AgentToolHost.
remaining: Detailed shell/session/log/approval and browser/CDP parity belong integration and UI reviews; tool availability alone is not full parity.
capabilities.evidenceScope: Read-only source comparison; existing named fixture results only. No tests or live services run in this audit.

priorityRecommendations.next: Parse and deduplicate four-protocol usage, retain per-round accounting without provider-wire pollution; use trusted context limits and complete tool-batch boundaries for guarded automatic compression. Test cancellation, fallback, partial usage, stale history and all four request serializers.

Define exact compatibility fixtures from pinned skill usage before adding bounded native Buffer/builtin/ESM primitives. Keep unsupported APIs explicit; do not advertise unchanged npm recipes until their imports and APIs work.

Implement owned archival memory/index and plans manifests with read-only/shared mount semantics and persisted environment keyframe/delta conversion; ordinary files or a compression memory tag do not satisfy these contracts.
Port provider-instance/auth/options semantics separately from generic wire adapters; fixtures should verify each source registry type and routed reasoning ownership before live validation.
Implement library research/LSP diagnostics, retry-edit-revert and remaining native preview codecs with their own authority/lifecycle fixtures.

evidenceLimits: Existing passing tests are scoped evidence only; no full suite was repeated and no universal defect-free guarantee is made.
